purpose: Public synthetic demonstration suite for exercising the source-grounded Google Search evaluation tooling. It is not the private hard certification used to rank production models.

candidate_protocol.response_requirements: auditable decision record only; no private chain-of-thought

referee_protocol.reference_pass: Expert referee creates a source-cited reference decision from the case before receiving a candidate answer.
referee_protocol.review_pass: Expert referee receives the frozen reference decision, the same source pack, and one anonymous candidate response.

reporting.certification_gate: Do not treat this synthetic public example as a production-operator leaderboard.

change_policy: Version substantive changes to this suite, source pack, or scoring rule before comparing results.
